summary: Immutep Limited filed a Form 6-K confirming a Nasdaq Listing Qualifications letter dated 12 October 2026 that the company regained compliance with the minimum bid price requirement under Listing Rule 5450(a)(1). The closing bid price of its ADSs was at or above US$1.00 for 10 consecutive business days from 28 September to 9 October 2026. To cure the prior deficiency flagged effective 27 April 2026, Immutep changed its ADS ratio from 1 ADS:10 ordinary shares to 1 ADS:200 ordinary shares effective 28 September 2026. Nasdaq closed the matter. No deal terms apply; ordinary shares continue trading on ASX as IMM and ADSs on Nasdaq as IMMP. The event is a compliance cure, not a special situation.
